$comment: Runtime configuration. Safety defaults: audit-only, no writes, one lead.

urls.$comment: Confirmed from the live app + operator notes.

marketStatus.$comment: REI Market Status vocabulary (confirmed from the live dropdown): New, Available, Unsold, Follow up, Contract Pending, Under Contract, Sold, Rented, Outsourced, Dead, Closed, Need to mail postcard, Invalid Lead, For Rent, Pending, Property Sold, Wrong Number, Do Not Mail, Interested, Cancelled Contract, Listed in the market, Declined offer, Unresponsive, Under Contract (Dispo).
marketStatus.$comment_mapping: Confirmed mapping: Evaluating='Follow up' and ClosedDead='Dead' auto-write (both backed by the rep's Lead Stage). ClosedWon=null (reserve Closed/Sold for an actual completed sale; hold). UnderContract=null (rare + high-stakes; hold for a human).

address.$comment_tidy: false = flag-only (recommended for unattended runs): capture ZIPs from notes, flag dupes/malformed, but do not rewrite street text. true = also tidy obvious suffix/casing.

run.$comment_notes: When true, a LIVE run auto-writes the explanatory note into REI for review/held/duplicate leads, so no person has to. Notes go on the property's communication/Notes tab.
run.$comment_activity: When true, a LIVE run will NOT write a status based on a low-confidence (heuristic) activity read — it holds + flags instead. Audit still reports the recommendation. Set a real contact.activityItem selector to raise reads to 'structured' and enable live writes.
